Median is a different robust combination than trimmed_mean; tests whether ignoring all but the middle value (more aggressive outlier rejection) helps on this trend-dominated series with one catastrophic model (catboost).
Mean over top-8 RMSE models, excluding naive group and extreme outlier; tests if trend-capable subset beats full-pool median in trend-dominated regime

Trend-dominated series (0.84); ARIMA is trend champion and best overall. Softmax weighting on pool4 (no catastrophic outlier) tests whether exploiting relative error differences within the top-8 beats the equal-weight mean leader.
DBA optimizes convex combination iteratively; different mechanism from mean/weighted, may exploit ARIMA-trend + rf-seasonal complementarity in pool4 better than uniform weights
Per-horizon top-k weighting to exploit moderate ranking stability (tau=0.43) where different models win at different steps of the 24-step horizon
Trim weakest models from pool4 to sharpen trend capture; different kind from mean/weighted/dba already tested
Trend-dominated series (trend_strength 0.84); inverse_error gives ARIMA (trend champion) the largest proportional weight, different weighting mechanism from softmax/topk already tested on pool4
Median is more robust than mean to the catboost models forecasting against the dominant downward trend (negative slope_z in test); trend_strength 0.84 makes directional errors costly
One-hot best-per-horizon on pool4: picks the single best model at each of 24 steps, exploiting moderate ranking instability (tau=0.429) more sharply than topk_per_horizon or inverse_error

Trend-dominated series (0.84): error_trend weights reward models improving across windows; swap in ONLY_CWT_rf (rank 2, different CWT decomposition) for DWT_catboost to diversify correlation groups while keeping top performers.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0785. Series context: trend strength 0.8408 and seasonal strength 0.3469; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.429); 2 of 14 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 750239164873.671.
